units.summary: New test checks that Size() on a Quantity built without a cached string returns a positive value and leaves q.s empty. It guards the non-mutating Size() contract and has no production effect.
units.headline: New test asserts Size() does not populate cached string
units.reason: A new test-only addition that cannot affect production behavior and adds coverage for the non-mutating Size contract.
